notes.title: Moon Strike Demo is Finally Live on Steam!
notes.content:
Greetings Moon Strike players,

We are thrilled to announce that the Moon Strike demo is finally live and available for download on Steam, the #1 platform for PC players.

Get ready to test your skills in multiplayer mode and challenge your friends to see who is the best. The chat system is now available during gameplay, allowing you to communicate with your teammates and strategize your moves.

And that’s not all! Starting in March, we will host monthly tournaments where you can win amazing prizes. So, what are you waiting for? Download the demo now and let the battle begin!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938560/Moon_Strike__Prologue/?beta=1
